I have farmed this small plot for many years, and I know these plants grow well with the cow dung and compost I collect from my homestead. I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or sprays from the cooperative, and the rains have always been enough for these trees and plants. My children and grandchildren will help me weed and harvest when the time comes, so I do not need to hire workers from outside.
